promise: Provide Ukraine an $8.1 billion, 48-month Extended Fund Facility arrangement approved in February 2026
description: The IMF approved Ukraine's approximately $8.1 billion, 48-month EFF on February 26, 2026. The July 20 first review enabled about $690 million in further disbursement, bringing the programme total described by the IMF to about $2.2 billion.
evidence: First review completed July 20, 2026 with about $690 million disbursed

review.note: Dates, approximate amounts and 48-month duration supported. First review enables disbursement; avoid treating approval as bank-settlement proof. The exact February 28, 2030 contractual expiry was not established.
